summary: The solution suffers from critical evaluation flaws and data leakage. The agent fits a LabelEncoder on the combined train and test sets (leaking test data) and imputes missing values before cross-validation (leaking validation data). Furthermore, while the agent sets up cross-validation, it entirely fails to evaluate the validation sets or compute any metrics, making its hardcoded ensemble weights completely arbitrary.
